snippet.title: WASD: The Adventure of Tori l Official Trailer
snippet.description:
WASD: The Adventure of Tori l Official Trailer


[WASD : The Adventure of Tori] is an online co-op game for 2–4 players

where each player can only use their automatically assigned key 
(W, A, S, or D). 

Even a small mistake can make the team fail, so talk with your teammates and work together! You’ll learn the rest by crashing into it… a lot.

Laugh, shout, blame your friends… and try again! Play with family, friends, or anyone nearby.

Want to get closer to your friends? Play WASD: The Adventure of Tori together! Probably...?

Let's go have some fun laughing together with our friends!

[STEAM LINK] 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3811390/WASD/
